# capture device

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/captureDevice>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

The physical device (camera, scanner, screen-capture hardware) that captured the media. Non-functional: multiple devices may be asserted (e.g. a composite image).
